pages.title: Two Tracks
pages.text: This page maps beast_bestiary.json, BEAST_PUPPET_v63.md, puppet_definitions.json, and puppet_craft_recipes.json. The source materials separate two systems: spirit beasts are tamed partners bound by blood-contract style rituals; puppets are crafted equipment-like constructs driven by blueprints, materials, divine sense, and methods.

pages.title: Beast Tiers
pages.text: The beast table maps tiers 1-13 to cultivation realms. Beast cores generally appear from tier 5, and tier 7+ connects to shape-shifting minor tribulations. The current mod has beast_core, spirit_beast_bone, spirit_beast_bridle, beast_taming_whip, and Yuling Pavilion contribution supply; real beast entities, affinity, growth, and ecology are still deferred.

pages.title: Taming Gates
pages.text: tame_requirements usually use realm_min, items, method_any, ritual, success_base, quests, and tame_allowed. Low-tier examples such as Twin-Pupil Rat use a bridle and basic taming method; Wind Screech Hawk expects Foundation and flight support; Gold-Devouring Beetles and Soul-Weeping Beasts are chance encounters; fierce jiao and giant apes are mostly not tameable.

pages.title: Puppet Crafting
pages.text: Puppet definitions advance from T0 to T6: basic wood puppets, giant ape puppets, giant turtle puppets, stone spirit puppets, Hunyuan-core upgrades, and Spirit-Realm prototypes. Craft-learning gates usually include realm_min, qianzhu_puppet_art or dayan_art, blueprints/cores, divine_sense_min, and quest_unlock.

pages.title: Current Hooks
pages.text: Current hooks include the Yuling Pavilion shop, Extreme West Thousand Bamboo region, Thousand Bamboo Puppet Tower secret realm, spirit-taming/Thousand Bamboo/Great Development manuals, and loaded technique data such as Spirit Beast Command Art, Puppet Mechanism Art, Great Development Formula, and beast-symbiosis arts. These are mostly data and learning hooks, not live beast or puppet units yet.

pages.title: Next Work
pages.text: Future slices should reuse ShopService, TechniqueManualItem, ArtifactDataService, worldpack secret realms, and the existing GeckoLib/FTB Quests prerequisites. Deferred work includes beast entities and AI, contracts/affinity, bridle consumption, puppet assembly benches, custom recipes, puppet entities or summons, repair fuel, loot tables, and quest guidance.
